Text: As a member, I want to spend 500 of my posted points as an SGD 5 voucher at the till, so that my points reduce what I pay.
Rationale: First end-to-end slice of epic LOY-210 (workflow steps, one fixed voucher value); must-have for launch per SH-01.

Text: As a member, I want to choose how many of my posted points to turn into a voucher, so that I can use more of my balance in one purchase.
Rationale: Business rule variation split from epic LOY-210; SH-01 rated it could for launch.

Text: As a support agent, I want to cancel a member's unused voucher, so that the member gets the points back without a manual points adjustment.
Rationale: Workflow step split from epic LOY-210 so support can resolve voucher complaints; SH-01 rated it should.
